description: This file is a shell script used for managing gtest application downloads and cleanup on an embedded system or build environment. It includes functions for downloading test apps based on a manifest, cleaning apps, and logging activities.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to the log file.

methods.name: clean_gtest_app
methods.description: Removes directories related to a specific gtest app and unmounts associated paths.

methods.name: download_all_gtest_apps
methods.description: Iterates over the manifest file to download all gtest applications listed.
